verdict.rationale: Anthropic's transparency hub links a published system card PDF for Claude Fable 5.1 and Claude Mythos 5.1 and summarizes safety testing across three risk areas, so a first-party system card exists. The evidence does not show that this card covers the model the docs call the current flagship, which the API changelog names as Opus 5.5. It also confirms only safety-testing content, not the other elements of the story. Missing for 10: confirmation that the system card covers the current flagship (Opus 5.5); evidence the card documents capabilities, training approach, evaluation results and intended use; independent corroboration.
